commits: fix: resolve docs enrich registry presets

requirements.desc: docs enrich must call resolveChaptersOrder with the current project root when resolving preset chapter names from ctx.type.
requirements.note: R1: docs enrich uses the current project root when building chapter prompts

requirements.desc: A project whose .senti/config.json type references plugin registry presets must resolve those presets during docs enrich without Preset not found warnings for valid registry entries.
requirements.note: R2: docs enrich resolves valid registry presets without Preset not found warnings

requirements.desc: docs init, docs readme, plugin registry loading, and builtin fallback behavior for genuinely unknown presets must remain unchanged by this bugfix.
requirements.note: R3: root-aware enrich behavior coexists with existing resolver fallback

entries.reason: Spec gate failed because migration parity inventory and behavior-level verification were missing from spec.json.
entries.resolution: Added migration parity inventory, retained behavior mapping, and behavior-level verification acceptance criteria to spec.json.

entries.reason: Test review failed because the first spec-local tests used source regex checks instead of exercising docs enrich runtime behavior.
entries.resolution: Replaced regex-focused tests with runtime DocsEnrichCommand execution against a temporary registry preset project and explicit fallback verification.

entries.reason: Impl review failed because the new spec-local regression file was untracked and absent from the review diff input.
entries.resolution: Staged src/docs/commands/enrich.js and specs/308-docs-enrich-preset-root so the implementation review can inspect the spec-local regression artifact.

entries.reason: Impl review tooling failed because staged generated spec artifacts expanded the diff and produced invalid nonBlockingImprovements schema output.
entries.resolution: Unstaged generated artifacts and used intent-to-add only for the new spec-local test so review input contains production change plus acceptance test coverage.

entries.resolution: Expanded acceptance criteria with explicit behavior-level parity verification for docs build, init, readme, and resolveChaptersOrder.

entries.resolution: Added executable docs init and docs readme checks using the same temporary registry preset project and templates.
